description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Ice Mode I (Umaro)] and [Ice Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Ice Mode I (Umaro)
description.text: Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for equipped Ice abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Ice Mode II (Umaro)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Ice Mode II (Umaro)
description.text: Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Ice abilities, grants [100% Critical (15s)], [Raging Yeti Mode] and [ATK +50%, DEF and RES -30% (8s)] to the user after using Ice abilities

description.name: Raging Yeti Mode
description.text: Casts Dual Snowball Toss after using equipped Ice abilities, removed after casting Dual Snowball Toss three times

description.name: Dual Snowball Toss
description.text: One single attack (2.64) capped at 99999, 100% hit rate

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3
